features.description: Filling one, two or three middle reels with wilds wins Mini, Major or Mega.

review:
A Route 66 road trip on 50 lines, with mystery wilds and jackpots.

The free spins have clear milestones: fill one of reels 2, 3 or 4 completely with wilds for the Mini, two full reels for the Major, and all three for the Mega. That makes the bonus much more interesting than most 50-line games. High volatility, 2,000x max and 96.27% RTP, with free spins about once every 145 spins.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 145 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
